name: Hui Hai
source:
The second in command at Qing Lian temple. A keen-observer but rather naïve man who, like his elder brother, became a full fledged-monk in Qing Lian temple. HuiHai is known to be adored by the temple's lady-parishioners not only for his looks but also for his gentle and caring personality. 

Voiced by: Sen Zhong Ren 森中人
